report.quality_scope: Existing fixed-user-message tau2 harness and ACTION reward. No official interactive tau2 success claim. Turn-cap hits reported explicitly.
report.measurement: Live task wall time, including BERT and per-turn D3/tool cleanup; model loading and warmup excluded. One execution per task/policy/repetition.
report.comparison_rule: Paired speed uses the same successful, outcome-matched task/repetition set for all six policies. All failures and mismatches remain reported. A single repetition does not estimate per-task timing variability.
